title.zh: 【IMF 批准向萨尔瓦多拨款 1.39 亿美元，就此前违反限制增持比特币给予豁免】
title.en: 【IMF 批准向萨尔瓦多拨款 1.39 亿美元，就此前违反限制增持比特币给予豁免】

current_state.zh: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador and granted a waiver after the country breached program conditions by further accumulating Bitcoin, while citing progress on AML, fiscal transparency, and transferring control of the Chivo wallet to private operators.
current_state.en: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador and granted a waiver after the country breached program conditions by further accumulating Bitcoin, while citing progress on AML, fiscal transparency, and transferring control of the Chivo wallet to private operators.
